summary.amount_warning: Finding amounts have different meanings and may overlap. Never sum them as revenue lost, recovered or at risk.

findings.title: Purchase signal conflicts with supplied policy
findings.explanation: A purchase signal is present although this order/destination is marked not permitted. This is a policy-contract exception, not a legal determination.
findings.next_step: Inspect the consent/policy mapping and emission path before further collection. Do not infer legal compliance from this tool.
findings.confidence: Observed exception under supplied mapping and completeness assumptions; not a verified cause or recovered revenue.

findings.title: COD collection has an overdue unsettled balance
findings.explanation: Mature courier collections exceed allocated gross settlements. Settlements are conservatively allocated to the oldest collections first.
findings.next_step: Reconcile the courier statement, bank transfer and recognized fees/adjustments. Confirm the contractual due date.
findings.amount_basis: overdue unsettled COD balance under configured grace; not lost revenue
findings.confidence: Observed exception under supplied mapping and completeness assumptions; not a verified cause or recovered revenue.

findings.title: Delivered order has a recorded collection shortfall
findings.explanation: Delivery is recorded and the configured grace period elapsed, but gross customer collections do not cover the final order total.
findings.next_step: Verify cash receipt, payment terms and final order amount with the gateway or courier. Do not charge the customer automatically.
findings.amount_basis: unmatched delivered order balance; not proven bad debt
findings.confidence: Observed exception under supplied mapping and completeness assumptions; not a verified cause or recovered revenue.

findings.title: Recorded collection exceeds the order total
findings.explanation: Distinct successful collection transactions exceed the supplied final order total; a mapping error is also possible.
findings.next_step: Verify transaction identities, order edits and legitimate adjustments with payments operations before considering any refund.
findings.amount_basis: gross collection above final order total; not lost revenue
findings.confidence: Observed exception under supplied mapping and completeness assumptions; not a verified cause or recovered revenue.

findings.title: Multiple purchase identities for one order
findings.explanation: Distinct normalized deduplication keys were observed for one order/destination. Actual downstream double counting is not established.
findings.next_step: Inspect browser/server identity alignment and the destination's own deduplication results. Never infer Meta, TikTok and GA4 share one dedup rule.
findings.confidence: Observed exception under supplied mapping and completeness assumptions; not a verified cause or recovered revenue.

findings.title: Purchase value differs from its configured basis
findings.explanation: Expected 5000 minor units for this destination; at least one observation differs. Tax/shipping conventions are configured, not guessed.
findings.next_step: Verify each destination's value definition, discounts, tax and shipping treatment against the source order.
findings.confidence: Observed exception under supplied mapping and completeness assumptions; not a verified cause or recovered revenue.

findings.title: Expected purchase signal is absent
findings.explanation: No purchase signal exists in the declared complete destination export after the configured grace period.
findings.next_step: Verify identity mapping, consent snapshot, integration delivery logs and downstream receipt before resending anything.
findings.confidence: Observed exception under supplied mapping and completeness assumptions; not a verified cause or recovered revenue.

findings.title: Purchase currency differs from the expected basis
findings.explanation: Observed purchase currency differs from the canonical order currency. Cross-currency amounts are not subtracted.
findings.next_step: Check whether the destination intentionally uses shop currency versus presentment currency and correct the mapping contract first.
findings.confidence: Observed exception under supplied mapping and completeness assumptions; not a verified cause or recovered revenue.
